items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: So there we were. I got Hibler and Walter Brown.

ctx.x: Well, in the meantime, Hibler called Kansas City and Kansas City called me in Oklahoma. They says -- and then I got in touch with Hibler. So Hibler says, "Man, I just found out. That girl's been intercepting the telegrams. And I done give up and I says you done give me a dirty deal." I says, "Well, no. Can you get out of there now?" He says, "Yeah, I can get out of here in the morning." I says, "Well, all right, look here, I'll get some money to you tonight. You get out of there in the morning and come on in and…

So there we were. I got Hibler and Walter Brown. And Walter Brown's thing was just one of them quick things that we got together on, because the other blues and things that we did, we did after he joined, after "Confessing the Blues."
